title: Jonah and the Vector
author: C. M. Reyes
blurb: Felix Vasquez, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
